Ordinary arrow projectile speed = live fArrowSpeedMult (default 1500) * equipped TESAmmo.speed.
Non-predictive fallback subtracts target GetPos from shooter GetPos, normalizes the 3D vector, then derives heading relative to shooter rotation.
